# CANDIDATE: VOL_CONTRACT_RIBBON_EXPANSION_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Volatility contraction (ATR below its 50-day 20th percentile) combined with an EMA ribbon state shift from flat to ascending captures the transition from low-volatility compression to a new trend. This edge exists because low ATR indicates reduced selling pressure and institutional accumulation, while the ribbon transition confirms momentum alignment across multiple timeframes, signaling institutional trend participation.

## Mechanism

Entry: When (1) 20-period ATR < 20th percentile of its 50-day lookback, (2) VIX < 15, (3) 8-21-34 EMA ribbon transitions from flat to ascending (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA34 on two consecutive 5-minute bars), and (4) price closes above the ribbon (above EMA8), then go long at the next bar's open.  
Exit: Initial stop at the lowest low during the ATR contraction period (chart stop). Profit target at 2× risk (RR=2). Runner position uses a 10% trailing chandelier exit (ATR-based trail).  
Regime filters: Only active between 09:45-11:30 ET. Avoid entry if ribbon direction changes >3 times in last 20 bars (choppy market filter).

2. **Sample bias:** Proposed trigger has zero historical backtest; sample size = 0. High overfit risk due to novel indicator combination without prior validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out window tested).

5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: whipsaw in low-VIX trending market (ribbon false breakout). Max drawdown: consecutive losses during volatility expansion regimes. Blow-up scenario: volatility expansion during entry (ATR rising post-entry) triggering stop loss while runner gets whipsawed by trailing exit.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to determine if top-5 days drive P&L.
